inputs: saved external_covariates.jsonl and external_similarity_top10.jsonl; validate names,E,prediction,containment flags against both saved ledgers
metrics: n,category counts,raw prediction Spearman,GC and loglength Spearman,within-subset rank residual correlation after intercept+GC rank+loglength rank
selection: same-assay retrospective combination of previously selected similarity and covariate audits; no model refit or E-tuned thresholds
limits: descriptive conditional sensitivity, not causal adjustment or explained fraction;top10 unflagged not homology-free;shared source selection unresolved;ordinalE not abundance/calibration;no pancreatic/clinical/independent validation;no raw sequence redistribution
